test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In 2024, which of the following Indian banks launched the Green Rupee Term Deposit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• SBI Green Rupee Term Deposit is offered in three distinct tenures - 1,111 days, 1,777 days, and 2,222 days.
 
• The deposit has been introduced to mobilize funds to support environment-friendly initiatives and projects.
 
• This will result in fostering the growth of a green finance ecosystem in India.
 
• The program is available to all persons, including non-resident Indians, and provides investors with the opportunity to choose from three separate tenors: 1,111 days, 1,777 days, and 2,222 days.
 
• This project Directly supports eco-friendly projects, promoting renewable energy, afforestation, and sustainable practices. Provides competitive interest rates, ensuring financial growth
 
• The interest rates for 1,111 days, 1,777 days, and 2,222 days are 6.65%, 6.65% and 6.40% respectively

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
